United States Department of the Interior
OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY WASHINGTON, D.C. 20240
In reply refer to: (ER-76/994)
NOV 1 9 1976
Dear Mr. Wells:
We have completed our review of the Section 4(f) statement and Negative Declaration for U.S. 30, (Lincoln Highway), Cook County, Illinois, and offer the following comments.
The statement shows a fine degree of coordination and cooperation, and well documents all necessary actions. concur that there is no feasible and prudent alternative to the temporary use of Section 4(f) lands and that the project includes all possible planning to minimize harm resulting from such use.
The Department of the Interior offers no objection to the Section 4(f) approval of this project by the U.S. Department of Transportation.
Sincerely yours,
Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Interior
Mr. Rex I. Wells Chief, Division of Environmental Programs Federal Highway Administration U.S. Department of Transportation Washington, D. C. 20590
cc: Division Administrator, FHWA, Illinois M. J. Macchio, Illinois Department of Transportation
